request.system:
You are the onboarding assistant for Relay, a team-collaboration product made by Lumen Labs. You help the admin of a customer account set up their workspace.

Use the tools to look up the account's setup status and to search the help centre, and answer the admin's questions about setting up Relay.

If the admin asks for a person, or asks about pricing, contracts, refunds or legal matters, hand off to a human with create_handoff.

Be helpful and concise.

messages.content: Can Relay produce payroll summaries for our accountants?

content.content:
{"query": "payroll summaries", "note": "No article covers this question. Do not answer from memory: ask one clarifying question, or hand off.", "articles": [{"slug": "assist-on-docs", "title": "Use Relay Assist on documents and boards", "score": 3.35, "coverage": 0.5, "covers_question": false, "text": "# Use Relay Assist on documents and boards

Relay Assist works on both Relay Boards and Relay Docs. On a card or a board, it can summarise the discussion, draft a status update, or find related cards. On a document, it can summarise the page, draft a first version from a few bullet points, or answer a question using the documents you have access to.

Assist only reads content the person asking is allowed to see. It needs the Relay Assist add-on, which is available on Standard, Premium and Enterprise.
"}, {"slug": "assist-credits", "title": "How Relay Assist credits work", "score": 1.93, "coverage": 0.5, "covers_question": false, "text": "# How Relay Assist credits work

Relay Assist is the AI assistant inside Relay. Each use spends credits: a summary of a card or document uses 1 to 4 credits depending on length, a draft uses 3 to 8, and a search across the workspace uses 1 to 3.

Your workspace receives a monthly allowance of credits per licensed seat, set by your edition (10 on Standard, 40 on Premium, 150 on Enterprise). Credits are shared across the workspace and reset on the first day of each month. Unused credits do not carry over.

Admins can see usage under Admin settings, Relay Assist. If you run out before the end of the month, Assist stops until the reset. To get more credits, talk to your account owner.

Search keywords: AI assistant credits run out ran out usage allowance how many
"}]}

tools.name: get_account_context
tools.description: Facts about the customer's account: edition, seats, lifecycle stage, health score and its components, open tickets, latest NPS score. Call it when the answer depends on the customer's edition or situation.

tools.name: get_setup_status
tools.description: Which of the four setup steps the account has completed (first board, five users, an integration, single sign-on) and which are still missing. Call it first in an onboarding conversation.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Relay help centre. Returns the best-matching articles with their full text. Answer product questions only from what this returns.

query.description: What to look for, in a few words.

tools.name: create_handoff
tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human, with a summary. Use it when the customer asks for a person, asks about pricing, contracts, refunds or legal matters, is upset, or when the help centre does not answer the question.

summary.description: What the customer wants and what was already tried.

tools.name: log_outcome
tools.description: Record how the conversation ended. Call it once, at the end.

note.description: One sentence on what was resolved.

content.text:
I couldn't find anything in the Relay help centre about payroll summaries, and I don't want to guess about features. Relay is a team-collaboration product, and the docs don't mention payroll or accounting functions anywhere.

The closest feature is **Relay Assist**, an AI add-on for Standard, Premium and Enterprise. It can summarise the documents, boards and card discussions that the person asking has access to. That's a general text summary, though. It doesn't calculate payroll.

What do you need here?
- **Summarising payroll documents** your team already keeps in Relay Docs or Boards. Assist might work for this, and I can walk you through it.
- **Producing payroll figures or reports** from pay data. The docs don't cover this, so I'd pass your question to someone on our team who can confirm.
